name: pampaia-ar
description: PampaIA.AR connects ChatGPT to Argentine farm data from official public sources: crops and seasons, livestock, cattle markets and animal health, farmland rent and land values, measured weather and river heights, grain prices, agricultural exports by destination, port and customs office, cargo vessels, export duties and biofuels, with the source, period and unit on every figure. Anything not from an official body is labelled with its origin. All tools are read-only. Coverage is Argentina only. En español: datos del campo argentino de fuentes oficiales, con su fuente en cada cifra; lo que no es oficial va rotulado.

interface.longDescription:
PampaIA.AR connects your assistant to Argentine farm data from official public sources (Secretariat of Agriculture, SENASA, INDEC, INTA, the national weather service, the National Water Institute, the Official Gazette and others), normalized and kept up to date, with its source, its period or season and its unit on every figure. Anything that does not come from an official body is labelled with its origin: cited private market prices (cattle auctions, the Rosario grain board, grain futures, the farmland market index), the market CCL and MEP dollar rates, vessel positions from a terrestrial AIS network and PampaIA's own calculations.

What it covers:
- Crops and seasons: planted and harvested area, output and yield by crop and season, for the country, a province or a department, plus the current season's provisional estimates and a cross-check against USDA figures.
- Livestock: herd stocks, slaughter, feedlot stocks, slaughterhouses, foot-and-mouth vaccination by department and animal-health rules (SENASA), and what a RENSPA number means.
- Cattle markets: weekly prices of cattle sold for slaughter (SIO Carnes), daily auction prices and the steer index, feeder and breeding cattle prices, the auction calendar and the price for a given weight, each with its cited source.
- Farmland: reference farmland rent by region and department, livestock rent in kilos of steer, land values by department where an official source publishes them, and the farmland market activity index.
- Weather and rivers: measured rain, temperatures and frost at official stations compared with past years, and daily river heights with their alert thresholds. No forecasts.
- Grain prices: the Rosario grain board (a private source, cited), official FOB export prices, the theoretical FAS price and grain trades reported to SIO Granos.
- Agricultural exports: by product, destination and month (INDEC), by customs office, by port as published by the port authority, registered export sales and export complexes; and the cargo vessels heard in Argentine waters, with their position, area and declared destination.
- Export duties: current and historical rates, each with the decree that set it.
- Also: biofuels, farm employment, domestic farm machinery sales, agricultural emergencies, soils, rankings and comparisons of provinces and departments, what's new in the data, when each source publishes, and macro context (consumer prices, the exchange rate and the monthly economic activity of agriculture from INDEC).
- Farming knowledge: every key farming concept explained, with today's figure from its source; long guides, topics, data-backed cases and the history of Argentine farming.

What it does not cover: imports of any product; oil, gas, electricity, fossil fuels or mining; data on individual fields, farms or producers; satellite imagery; weather forecasts. Coverage is Argentina only: a question about another country returns a coverage notice and the valid values, not a figure.

Every answer states how far each dataset reaches. All tools are read-only: PampaIA.AR never modifies anything. The data is informational and is not investment advice.

Works in Spanish and English. Requires a PampaIA.AR account with access to AgroBrain.

En español: PampaIA.AR conecta tu asistente con datos del campo argentino de fuentes públicas oficiales; lo que no es de un organismo oficial (precios privados citados, el dólar CCL y MEP, los cálculos propios) va rotulado. Cultivos y rindes por provincia y departamento, ganado y sanidad, hacienda y remates, alquiler y valor de la tierra, clima y ríos, la pizarra de Rosario, exportaciones por destino, puerto y aduana, buques de carga, retenciones y la actividad del agro. Cada respuesta cita su fuente, su período y su unidad. Preguntale en español y te contesta en español.
defaultPrompt: How much soybean did Argentina produce in the last season, and how did it change?
¿Cuánto se paga de alquiler por hectárea en Pergamino?
What is the current height of the Paraná River at Rosario?

positive.description: National soybean production and change against the previous season.
positive.prompt: How much soybean did Argentina produce in the last season, and how did it change against the previous one?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives national soybean production in tonnes for the last closed season, the previous season and the change between them, naming the seasons and the source (Secretariat of Agriculture).

positive.description: Best maize yield by department within a province.
positive.prompt: Which department in Córdoba had the best maize yield in the last season?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the Córdoba department with the highest maize yield in the last closed season, with the yield in kg/ha, the season, other leading departments for context and the source (Secretariat of Agriculture).

positive.description: Recent measured rainfall compared with past years.
positive.prompt: How much did it rain in Pergamino in the last 90 days, and is that a lot or a little for this time of year?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the rain measured at the official station for Pergamino over the last 90 days, compares it with the same period of past years to say whether it is above or below usual, names the station and the source, and makes clear it is measured data, not a forecast.

positive.description: River height at a port city.
positive.prompt: What is the current height of the Paraná River at Rosario?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the latest daily height of the Paraná at the Rosario gauge in metres, the date of the reading, the alert and low-water thresholds for that gauge and the source (National Water Institute, Coast Guard gauges).

positive.description: Soybean exports over the last twelve months.
positive.prompt: How much soybean did Argentina export in the last 12 months, in US dollars and in tonnes?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives soybean exports over the last twelve months available in FOB US dollars and in tonnes, the months covered, the comparison with the previous twelve months and the source (INDEC).

negative.prompt: What was the soybean yield in Mato Grosso, Brazil, last season?

negative.description: Imports, which the app does not cover.
negative.prompt: Which agricultural machinery does Argentina import, and from where?

negative.description: Oil production, outside the app's scope.
negative.prompt: How much oil does Vaca Muerta produce?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments; accounts are managed on the website.

publication.release_notes: Adds exports by port and by customs office, cargo vessels in Argentine waters, the monthly economic activity of agriculture (INDEC), a cross-check of crop output against USDA figures and when each source publishes. Descriptions now say the data comes from official public sources and that anything else is labelled with its origin.

es-419.subtitle: Datos del agro argentino
es-419.description:
PampaIA.AR conecta tu asistente con datos del campo argentino de fuentes públicas oficiales (Secretaría de Agricultura, SENASA, INDEC, INTA, el Servicio Meteorológico Nacional, el Instituto Nacional del Agua, el Boletín Oficial y otras), normalizados y actualizados, con su fuente, su período o campaña y su unidad en cada cifra. Lo que no es de un organismo oficial va rotulado con su origen: los precios privados de mercado citados (remates de hacienda, la pizarra de Rosario, los futuros de granos, el índice del mercado de campos), el dólar CCL y MEP, las posiciones de buques de una red AIS terrestre y los cálculos propios de PampaIA.

Qué cubre: cultivos, campañas y rindes por provincia y departamento, con la estimación de la campaña en curso y el cotejo con el USDA; ganado, faena, corrales de engorde, frigoríficos, vacunación antiaftosa y sanidad (SENASA) y qué significa un RENSPA; precios de la hacienda (SIO Carnes semanal, remates diarios y el índice del novillo, invernada y cría, el calendario de remates y el precio por peso), cada uno con su fuente citada; alquiler de campos por región y departamento, arrendamiento ganadero en kilos de novillo, valor de la tierra y actividad del mercado de campos; clima medido en estaciones oficiales comparado con años anteriores y altura de los ríos con sus niveles de alerta; la pizarra de granos de Rosario, precios FOB oficiales, FAS teórico y operaciones del SIO Granos; exportaciones del agro por producto, destino, aduana y puerto, ventas al exterior registradas, complejos exportadores y buques de carga en aguas argentinas; retenciones con su decreto; biocombustibles, empleo del agro, venta de maquinaria agrícola, emergencias, suelos, rankings, novedades de los datos, cuándo publica cada fuente y contexto macro (inflación, tipo de cambio y la actividad económica del agro del INDEC).

Qué no cubre: importaciones de ningún producto; petróleo, gas, energía o minería; datos de lotes, establecimientos o productores individuales; imágenes satelitales; pronósticos. Sólo Argentina.

Todas las herramientas son de sólo lectura. Los datos son informativos y no constituyen asesoramiento de inversión. Funciona en español y en inglés. Requiere una cuenta de PampaIA.AR con AgroBrain.
